title: Koudou Saisoku Densetsu: Initial D
native_title: 公道最速伝説 頭文字Ｄ
overview:
The Hachi-Roku tears down the road in a heated downhill battle!! You're the one who will conquer the mountain pass!!

Based on Shuichi Shigeno's street racing manga Initial D, this racer puts you behind the wheel of the famous Hachi-Roku for downhill duels on winding mountain roads. Take on a long line of rivals in one-shot downhill battles, where a single run decides who rules the pass.

During a race, the character window shows your rival's face so you can read what is going through their mind. Between battles, push your own limits against the ghost car, which replays your fastest run so you can chase the perfect lap.

- One-on-one downhill battles against many rivals
- Ghost car that recreates your best run
- Character window showing your rival's reactions
- Racing Controller and Sega Multi Controller compatible

ハチロクが疾走る、白熱のダウンヒルバトル！！
峠を制するのはキミだ！！
